identity.hierarchyPrinciple: One claim leads; evidence rail, product proof, and provenance follow.
identity.distinctiveMove: A single evidence rail connects the promise to three observations and the real product feed.

surfaces.borderStrategy: Ink rules and one warm hairline separate content; no decorative border stack.

effects.name: paper-grid
effects.purpose: Give the quiet research canvas a measured editorial texture without creating a focal point.

media.treatment: Keep the FinHot UI literal in a quiet proof window subordinate to the claim.
media.cropPolicy: Preserve navigation, the active feed state, and first feed rows; crop only repeated lower rows.

components.name: headline-block
components.geometry: Left-aligned editorial title occupying the upper field.

components.name: evidence-rail
components.purpose: Bind the three locked evidence statements into one sequential proof.
components.geometry: One vertical accent rule with three aligned evidence rows.

components.name: product-proof
components.purpose: Show the literal FinHot interface after the evidence claims.
components.geometry: Wide cropped interface window with a straight editorial frame.

components.name: provenance-footer
components.purpose: Keep source and financial disclaimer readable.
components.geometry: Two-column footer inside the bottom safe area.

do: Use the accent only to connect evidence.
Preserve literal product state and provenance.
avoid: Do not imitate a named brand.
Do not stack glow, glass, and gradient effects.
Do not crop decision-relevant product context.
